name: River Adaptation

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text: Webbing sprouts on your legs and tail as you shift to a more aquatic form. You can cast Feet to Fins as an innate divine spell once per day. This innate magic relies on your makari heritage, limiting the effect to yourself but allowing you to cast it more easily than a common mage; you can target only yourself with the spell, but you can Cast the Spell as a free action if you're within a body of water when you cast it.
